items.title: Surprise Billing Fight Splits Into Two Paths as Congress Weighs Pallone Overhaul Against Doctor-Backed Enforcement Bill - Medical Daily
items.reason: The item discusses congressional legislative proposals regarding surprise billing enforcement and the No Surprises Act implementation, which directly relates to federal rulemaking and policy direction affecting the Act's enforcement mechanisms.
items.summary: Congress is considering two competing legislative approaches to surprise billing: Congressman Pallone's proposed overhaul and a doctor-backed enforcement bill. The split reflects divergent priorities on how to strengthen or modify No Surprises Act enforcement, with implications for how independent dispute resolution and balance-billing protections are administered. Revenue-cycle teams should monitor these proposals as legislative changes could alter compliance requirements, IDR procedures, or enforcement timelines for out-of-network billing scenarios.
